title: The Marro
text: There is something you could tell her. The Vell's song-keeper wears a title worn down from a name: the Marro, for the first who came down, the one who carried their names.

choices.label: Tell her the Vell keep her name
choices.reply: "The Marro." She says it twice, trying it. "Then some of us lived. Somewhere, after. Take me to them when this is over. I want to hear it from them."

choices.label: Not now
choices.reply: It can wait. She has had enough for one day.

notes: Only with keeper-song (Act 1). marrow-vell: Marrow asks to meet the Vell (for the climax / endings writer).
